subject: Using Steered MD in NPT vs NVT vs NVE

messages.author: Ramdhan,Peter A
messages.body:
Hi all,
I am currently running a steered MD and needed some advice on what type of simulation to run. Based on examples in tutorials or scripts from others on the mailing list, it seems that most SMD runs are either NVT or NVE. Is this common practice? Is NPT not recommended?
Sincerely,
Peter Ramdhan, PharmD
